featured_reviews.review_text:
Somewhat hidden away across from the bustling Regal Circle, Avante is easily missed.  We started going there because of their lovely camel bone boxes, which have become a staple present for friends.

featured_reviews.name: Vinesh Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Avante Cottage Crafts was an A++++ experience.  Every time I look at the pieces I purchased, I not only remember my trip to Mumbai, but also the great shopping experience the staff provided.

The Pieces: The large selection of high quality pieces made it a one-stop shop for me.  I walked away with pieces that range from classical to modern, enhance any room, and make for great conversation.  I was most impressed with the wood-pressed painting and silk tapestries I purchased for my home.

The Staff: The staff is absolutely dedicated to service and ensuring you'll have a great experience.  They personally select the items they stock, and it shows in the way they help you.  Once the team knew more about my home and the aesthetic I was looking for, they were able to quickly pick out items I would like - explaining the origin, workmanship, and significance of each piece.  They even suggested ways to best display the pieces as an ensemble.

Shipping: Packaging and shipping were also very easy.  I decided not to ship the items so they were hand-delivered to my hotel room - free of charge (although I did tip).  Each piece was wrapped in bubble tape and styrofoam, and individually boxed.  I arrived home with showroom quality pieces and immediately put them on display.

Bottom line: I'll happily return on my next visit, and think you'll have as great an experience as I did.  The store is easy to find near the Regal Cinema; the selection of pieces are amazing; and the helpful staff is even better.

featured_reviews.name: anjitha mekkayil anand
featured_reviews.review_text:
Phillips Antiques, nestled in the heart of Mumbai's heritage district near Colaba, is more than just a shop; it's a living museum steeped in history. Established in 1860, this family-owned establishment is one of the oldest antique stores in the city, and stepping inside feels like a journey back in time.
The carefully curated collection is a treasure trove of colonial-era finds and exquisite pieces from across Asia. From magnificent carved wooden furniture – beds, armchairs, settees, and marble-topped tables – to delicate Victorian curios, gilded mirrors, and religious statues, every item tells a story. You'll find a fascinating array of lamps, lithographs, old maps, and photographs of pre-Independence Bombay, offering a nostalgic glimpse into the city's past.
The true charm of Phillips Antiques lies not just in its impressive inventory, but also in the passion and knowledge of its proprietors. They are more like curators, happy to share the provenance and significance of each piece, making the Browse experience educational and truly captivating. While the prices reflect the rarity and quality of the items, even if you're not in the market to buy, a visit to Phillips Antiques is a must for anyone with an appreciation for history, art, and the unique allure of old-world charm in modern Mumbai.

A highly recommended stop for genuine Kashmiri items and thoughtful service.

name: APRE Art House
description: APRE Art House is a contemporary art gallery based in Colaba, Mumbai, dedicated to advancing rigorous artistic practices and critical discourse. Founded by Prerna S.M. Jain, an alumna of Christie’s Education, New York, the gallery was established in 2022 as a two-level exhibition space supporting emerging and established artists. APRE extends its reach through curated projects in New York and New Delhi, and participation in leading international art fairs, including India Art Fair. Through exhibitions, public programming, and initiatives such as film screenings, Front Matter, The Forum, WARC+, performances and the APRE Artist Grant, APRE fosters research-led, interdisciplinary engagement within the contemporary art landscape.

featured_reviews.name: Kruti Suchak
featured_reviews.review_text: I had come here recently for Poets of Mumbai poetry meet. The art gallery is awesome and inspiring. I was personally touched by the darkness and light paintings and photography depicting family constellation and pattern. And the video shown too was inspiring. The event was beautifully organised. A must visit place for art lovers.

featured_reviews.name: Hrithika Purohit
featured_reviews.review_text: I’ve visited this art gallery a few times, they always have such lovely art shows. The gallery assistants/ curators are doing such a good job. They are always very helpful and give good tours of the show. I’ve also attended one of their workshops and I must say they are really doing something different. 10/10 recommend going here. I’ve also posted pics of the last show I saw there.

featured_reviews.name: Sorab Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: Nice little gallery tucked away in an unexpected residential area. There was some sort of a group show and some of the works were really striking and deep. The rains of Mumbai make it difficult because of water leakage and such. Nevertheless, the staff was nice, quiet and let me be, which I didn't mind. Thank you....

featured_reviews.name: Pranali Gada
featured_reviews.review_text:
This little piece of heaven situated in Colaba is timeless for the Art genre!  I followed Art Fervour weekender 2022 and this was my first visit.

Amazing curation, very refreshing artists and an art driven community with beautiful conversations. I' was introduced to  Victor Hazara's work for the first time and his art speaks volumes to me. Imagine a story for each picture with powerful strokes and fragments of time surrounding his colour palate.

Thankyou Prerna for being an amazing curator, really owe it to you. And all the people I met during the gallery!

featured_reviews.name: Ruchi Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: APRE, is one of the superior contemporary art gallery , as there past few shows have severed and communicated well to society through these collective contemporary artists and their paintings, they also have been doing lots of workshops in various fields such as performing arts, textiles, printing making and many more, one must visit to get inspirations. My experience from one the workshop I attended, one of the knowledgeable, inspiring, and creative workshop I have ever attended, thanks to APRE! Looking forward for more of such fun and interactive workshops…
